description: Technical provenance and loader checks for FLUXOS. These checks do not perform a hydraulic simulation or establish scientific validity.
source: Floodcast-authored checks against recorded build evidence and loader diagnostics.
license: Project-authored validation metadata; no third-party data. Repository redistribution license is not yet assigned.
expectations: Provenance verifies executable, declared recipe and evidence hashes, then exact installed packages against build inventory or a SHA-256-linked runtime inventory.
The loader verifies the executable hash, shared libraries and OpenMP, then checks that a missing-modset probe returns exit 1 with its expected diagnostic.
The mounted verifier is independently identified by its fixture SHA-256; no simulation is claimed by either technical check.
tolerance_rationale: Exact content hashes, package inventory and diagnostic/exit-code checks.
